description: Update vector, imagery, primitive, or 3D Tiles styling for a layer. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

imageryStyle.description: Imagery visual style (alpha, brightness, contrast, hue, saturation, gamma); use setLayerVisibility for show/hide

labelStyle.description: Label style (font, fillColor, outlineColor, outlineWidth, scale, etc.)

layerStyle.description: Entity layer style (color, opacity, strokeWidth, pointSize; GeoJSON thematic styles choropleth/category/randomColor/gradient are mutually exclusive)

primitiveStyle.description: GeoJSON Primitive material style (color, opacity, outlineColor, outlineWidth, pointSize, lineWidth); use setLayerVisibility for show/hide

sessionId.description: Target browser session ID for multi-browser routing (optional)

tileStyle.description: 3D Tiles style (Cesium3DTileStyle expressions: color, show, pointSize, meta)

name: updateLayerStyle
